query: SELECT c.id,c.ma,c.trang_thai,c.chua_doc_khach,c.chua_doc_nhan_vien,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_tin_nhan m WHERE m.hoi_thoai_id=c.id AND m.nguoi_gui_loai<>N'KHACH' AND m.da_xem_luc IS NULL) actual_unread_customer,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_tin_nhan m WHERE m.hoi_thoai_id=c.id AND m.nguoi_gui_loai=N'KHACH' AND m.da_xem_luc IS NULL) actual_unread_staff FROM chat_hoi_thoai c WHERE c.id=1
